Compute pseudo-bulk expression for a patient

Source: R/evaluate.R
each_patient_pseudo_bulk.Rd

Calculates weighted average of clone-level expression to produce a pseudo-bulk expression profile for a single patient. This is used for evaluating model performance on pseudo-bulk data, not for prediction.

Usage

each_patient_pseudo_bulk(
  x = 1,
  comb_viability_df,
  Clone_Counts_per_patients,
  clone_Level_z_expression_df
)

Arguments

x

Integer. Index of the patient. Default = 1.

comb_viability_df

Data frame. Retained for backward compatibility; no longer used (clone ids are read from the expression column names).

Clone_Counts_per_patients

Data frame. Patient-clone abundance data.

clone_Level_z_expression_df

Matrix. Clone-level expression data with columns named by patient-clone identifiers.

Value

Named numeric vector of pseudo-bulk expression values.
